title: Mismatch and affine-correction rejection
statement: Let $f:\mathbb F_2^N\to\{-1,1\}$, let $i$ be a coordinate, and let $b,b_0$ be Boolean values. If the affine-coordinate correction associated with $f$ and $i$ returns the sign encoding of $b_0$ with probability at least $1/2$ under a uniform choice of its auxiliary point, then $\frac12$ when $b\ne b_0$ (and $0$ when $b=b_0$) is at most one minus the probability that the same correction returns the sign encoding of $b$.
hypotheses_covered: The correction probability for b₀ is at least 1/2
